segments.description: Overhead high-angle shot of a classic wooden chessboard as Kasparov makes the opening move, initiating the match [[00:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=3)].
Close-up shot of hands interacting with the board as Short responds by inverting his rook to confuse opponent pieces [[00:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=13)].
Medium shot of white pieces reacting with physical chaos and fainting from gravity changes on the board [[00:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=21)].
Close-up shot of a knight modified with a unicorn horn and a pawn disguised with a miniature newspaper spy [[00:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=31)].
Medium shot of black bishop pieces displaying political dissent and forming a breakaway church faction [[00:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=48)].
Medium action shot of a miniature football match breaking out on the board alongside a festive snowman figurine [[01:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=75)].
Close-up shot of white pawns combining together into an elaborate mechanical mega-cheszatron formation [[01:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=85)].
Medium shot revealing the white queen to be an imitation played by actress Helen Mirren [[01:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=96)].
Wide overhead shot as Short stands up on his chair and takes a golf swing over the board [[01:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=111)].
Close-up action shot of Kasparov unorthodoxly urinating on the board to secure checkmate and claim victory [[02:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgeYScYe8wI&t=125)].
